title: fix(line): route bound LINE chats when agent selection is ambiguous
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes #159080. LINE messages in an actively session-bound conversation can fail with `AgentSelectionRequiredError` when multiple agents are configured without a channel-wide route. Group mention admission also selected an ordinary agent before the context builder could consult the binding.

## Why This Change Was Made

Use the existing shared binding inspection and route projection contract, following #123159. LINE inspects the binding once, lets group mention admission use the bound owner, and carries that captured decision into message-context construction.

For groups, the shared ingress owner first evaluates sender and group policy without consulting bindings. Only admitted group messages prepare a route; the same ingress owner then evaluates activation with the selected owner's mention facts. Explicitly disabled groups, disabled group policy, and denied senders therefore still settle during a binding-owner outage. Binding activity writes and configured ACP readiness remain after admission. No configuration, schema, SDK, or iMessage changes.

## User Impact

Bound direct and group conversations reach their existing agent without requiring a channel-wide route. Ambiguous unbound conversations still fail closed; single-agent and explicit channel routes keep working. Policy-rejected messages do not become retries because binding storage is unavailable.

## Evidence

Final head: `2d66459e93c177183021b10600f8520001cef650`.

- Baseline: pinned main `97b0a7c850091d215be1fe75b8326ca99d1f1232`, with its LINE production sources freshly built. Signed direct and group webhooks were durably accepted, then both failed with `AgentSelectionRequiredError` despite real active `SessionBindingService` bindings.
- Final candidate: repeated signed direct/group webhooks on a freshly built isolated Gateway reached `codex`, completed real agent turns against a scripted local model, and emitted `LINE_BOUND_OK` replies through mock LINE API transport. This is Gateway/channel-boundary proof, not a live LINE service test.
- Controls: ambiguous unbound group and retired-binding direct/group messages rejected routing. Single-agent and explicit channel-wide routes completed direct/group turns as `main` and emitted replies. The final replay repeated the ambiguous unbound-group control.
- Signed-handler regressions fail on the old sources and pass with the repair. The bound adapter retires its record after the first inspection, so a second lookup during context construction would lose the captured route. Parsing, sender admission, mention selection, and context construction are real; spool durability is covered separately.
- Outage regressions: with a throwing binding owner, `groupPolicy: disabled` and an allowlist-denied sender both returned HTTP 500 on `eeaf1bb9d7ec`; both now return HTTP 200 with no dispatch or handler failure. Explicitly disabled groups and disabled DMs also skip successfully.
- Five focused LINE suites (`bot-bound-route`, `bot-handlers`, `bot-handlers.join-intro`, `bot-message-context`, `bot-mention-context`): **143 passed**, 18.48 seconds test-runner wall. The two added outage cases took 7 ms and 6 ms in that run. The earlier isolated two-case signed regression cost 16.73 seconds wall including cold compilation with `--maxWorkers=1`.
- Fresh Gateway build, scoped Oxlint, LINE production types, touched test types, and `git diff --check` passed. Full repository suites were not run locally.

Observed final synthetic-fixture trace (session UUIDs omitted):

```text
main:
  spooled update message:baseline-direct failed; keeping for retry: Multiple agents are configured, but line account default routing has no explicit owner.
  spooled update message:baseline-group failed; keeping for retry: Multiple agents are configured, but line account default routing has no explicit owner.
final candidate:
  message processed: channel=line chatId=line:U_PROOF_USER messageId=final-direct sessionKey=agent:codex:line:proof:U_PROOF_USER outcome=completed duration=2573ms
  message processed: channel=line chatId=line:group:G_BOUND_PROOF messageId=final-group sessionKey=agent:codex:line:proof:G_BOUND_PROOF outcome=completed duration=1922ms
  POST /v2/bot/message/reply {"replyToken":"final-direct-reply","messages":[{"type":"text","text":"LINE_BOUND_OK"}]}
  POST /v2/bot/message/reply {"replyToken":"final-group-reply","messages":[{"type":"text","text":"LINE_BOUND_OK"}]}
negative control:
  spooled update message:final-unbound-group failed; keeping for retry: Multiple agents are configured, but line account default routing has no explicit owner.
```
